name: antigravity-cockpit
displayName: Antigravity Private Cockpit – 100% Offline AI Quota Monitor
description: 🔒 100% Offline & Private AI Quota Monitor for Antigravity IDE. Zero telemetry, zero external network requests, zero token leaks. Real-time Gemini & Claude quota tracker with a gorgeous bilingual dashboard.

agPrivateCockpit.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Auto-refresh polling interval in seconds (default: 15s, minimum: 5s).

agPrivateCockpit.compactStatusBar.description: Enable compact status bar mode to abbreviate model names (default: false).

agPrivateCockpit.warningThreshold.description: Quota percentage below which digits turn warning orange (default: 50%).

agPrivateCockpit.criticalThreshold.description: Quota percentage below which digits turn critical red (default: 20%).

agPrivateCockpit.defaultLanguage.description: Default display language for cockpit dashboard (auto / zh / en).

agPrivateCockpit.showGemini.description: Toggle Google Gemini quota visibility in the status bar (default: true).

agPrivateCockpit.showClaude.description: Toggle Anthropic Claude & GPT quota visibility in the status bar (default: true).

agPrivateCockpit.showTokenSpeed.description: Toggle recent conversation Token Speed (t/s) indicator on status bar (default: true).

agPrivateCockpit.showContextSaturation.description: Whether to display the context quota saturation meter on the status bar (是否在底部状态栏显示上下文额度饱和度)

agPrivateCockpit.contextWindowLimit.description: Model context window limit in tokens (Default 1,048,576 for Gemini 1M, 200,000 for Claude) (模型上下文额度上限 Tokens，默认 1,048,576 / 1M)

agPrivateCockpit.modelType.description: Target AI model window capacity for real-time context saturation telemetry (测算上下文额度饱和度时使用的目标模型窗口上限).

scripts.test: node test/verify_feature_map.js && node test/verify_dune_architecture.js && node test/verify_reversibility_gate.js
